items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: She said, she got me to sing with her on a gig.

ctx.x: Hey, I’m going to need it. But it’ll be easy. I don’t even look upon it as a challenge. It will be like falling off a log. Because I’ve been singing for years, I just haven’t really pushed it. Sue Rainey pushed me into it. She said, she got me to sing with her on a gig. She said, “why aren’t you doing this, you’re wonderful, do it.” And I took that and I said, “okay, Sue, if people throw tomatoes at me I’m going to blame you okay.” And she laughed but she’s one of the greatest things since sliced bread, that…
No. I’ve seen her name around quite a bit.
